name: Weight of Wings
description: A creature in a space occupied by the creature has its speed reduced by half, and must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or become blinded. Both effects end when the creature doesn’t share a space with the creature at the end of the creature’s turn. If a creature succeeds on the saving throw, it is immune to the creature’s blindness (but not the speed reduction) for 24 hours.
